cc:Work.dc:description: Conditional added-mass and auxiliary-power budget for fixed 4905 N downforce from rest and G12. Shared DC power is 1 MW, auxiliary draw is subtracted before drivetrain efficiencies. Zero-gain curve is relative to original 2000 kg G9 no-downforce baseline 1.822793 s. A=(0 kg,0 kW), B=(100 kg,100 kW), C=(500 kg,300 kW). Downforce is not derived from the hardware cost; no fan feasibility is asserted.
